a: Event envelopes include id, type, timestamp, producer, and payload.
CloudEvents is a standard format for event metadata across systems.
Version event types and keep consumers backward compatible when possible.
Transactional outbox writes events with DB changes, then publishes reliably.
Inbox tables de-duplicate received messages for idempotent consumers.
True end-to-end exactly-once is rare; aim for effective exactly-once via idempotency.
Backward/forward compatible schema changes protect producers and consumers.
Name events as past facts: OrderPlaced, PaymentCaptured.
Commands request work; events record that something happened.
CDC streams database row changes into event pipelines.
